title: Identity tangent operation compatibility
statement: Let k be any field and G a group object over Spec k, x its identity point, and r the structural residue-field homomorphism. Equip the dual-number tangent subtype at x with its specified additive group and with the k-module action obtained by restricting residue-field scalars along r. For every function F from infPoints G to this subtype whose underlying morphism on v is Spec.map (DualNumber.mapRingHom r) composed with the tangent-group point of v, F(v*w)=F(v)+F(w); and for every scalar t in k, F(infPointsScale G ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso k).inv t) v)=t • F(v). No bijectivity of F is required.

proof.text: Apply identity_tangent_transport_addition to obtain multiplication compatibility for the prescribed transport function F.

First prove the private scale_toSpec lemma: unfold dualNumbersToSpec, use toSpecΓ_naturality and combine the spectrum maps. Equality of the ring maps is coefficientwise: the constant coefficient is unchanged and the epsilon coefficient is multiplied by the scalar read through ΓSpecIso.inv. Cancel dualNumbersToSpec to obtain the conjugation formula for the scaling map. Coefficientwise calculation also proves that the dual-number map induced by the structural residue map commutes with scaling by t on k and by r(t) on the residue field. The chosen module specification from exists_tangentVectors_vectorSpace identifies its scalar action with precomposition by exactly that residue scaling map. Unfold infPointsScale and the underlying infPointsEquivTangentGroup map, use functoriality of inverses under Over.forget, and the two scaling identities. Associativity and subtype extensionality give the scalar compatibility identity. This holds also at scalar zero.

theorem identity_tangent_transport_operations
    {k : Type u} [Field k] (G : Over (Spec (.of k))) [GrpObj G] :
    let x := unitSection G (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k)
    let r : k →+* G.left.residueField x :=
      (StructureSheaf.toStalk k (G.hom x) ≫ G.hom.stalkMap x ≫ G.left.residue x).hom
    letI : Module k (schemeTangentSpace k G.left G.hom x) :=
      Module.compHom (schemeTangentSpace k G.left G.hom x) r
    ∀ F : infPoints G → schemeTangentSpace k G.left G.hom x,
      (∀ v : infPoints G, (F v).val =
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (DualNumber.mapRingHom r)) ≫
          (infPointsEquivTangentGroup G v).val.left) →
      (∀ v w, F (v * w) = F v + F w) ∧
      (∀ (t : k) v,
        F (infPointsScale G ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv.hom t) v) = t • F v)
